interview.name: Eli
interview.answer: After lunch, at the repair drive.

reflections: Eli is coordinating the repair drive in a practical, low-friction way, focusing on simple instructions and follow-up.
Vik is dependable and responsive, taking on the task of spreading the word and keeping momentum.
Rey is willing to help with concrete, organization-oriented work and is ready to take direction.
Eli is coordinating the repair drive in a calm, practical way and keeps plans simple.
Rey is cooperative and responsive when given clear tasks.
Nell and Faye are both willing to help, but each needs lightweight, concrete follow-through to stay aligned.
Faye is cooperative and dependable, responding clearly to scheduling logistics and willing to adjust to others' timing.
Eli tends to coordinate tasks in an organized, appreciative way and relies on others to keep plans moving smoothly.
Nell, Cleo, and Quinn each appear supportive and proactive, taking initiative on follow-up, supplies, and setup for the repair drive.
Eli tends to coordinate group work with clear follow-up timing and simple next steps.
Quinn, Mara, and Tess respond cooperatively and take ownership of concrete tasks.
The group works best with explicit check-ins and shared lists, especially for practical repair-drive prep.
Eli is coordinating the repair drive in a calm, organized way and keeps the group focused on the same next step.
Tess is helping identify what is still missing, while Rey and Sam are taking on concrete prep tasks, which suggests a cooperative, task-oriented group.
The relationships are practical and supportive rather than personal; people respond quickly to Eli’s direction and are comfortable committing to follow-up after lunch.

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to everyone I see and keep the plans moving.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: mention it to folks and we’ll check in after lunch.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll mention the repair drive to folks and we can check in after lunch.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Rey: I’m glad to help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Could you help sort the donated tools and then label the repair bins so we can keep everything organized?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the repair bins.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I haven’t heard a new update yet, but I’m still checking around. Last I knew they could use a few tools and some extra hands.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. Let’s keep it simple: keep asking around for tools and extra hands, and we’ll check in after lunch.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep asking around and see what I can line up before then.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the pickup and drop-off windows, and I’ll work around them.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye. I’ll send the pickup and drop-off windows, and we can keep the plan straightforward.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Faye: Perfect — send them over when you can, and I’ll make sure my schedule lines up.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking the supplies now, and I’ll let you know exactly what’s still missing for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. Please let me know what’s missing, and I’ll keep the list organized so we can fill the gaps.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll tally up what we have and send you the missing items as soon as I’m done.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. Could you help sort the donated tools and label the repair bins so we can keep everything organized?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll help sort the donated tools and label the repair bins so everything stays organized.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Quinn. Let’s check in after lunch and make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Mara. Let’s check in after lunch and make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mara: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll check back after lunch and keep things moving.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Eli: Perfect — after lunch we’ll do a quick check and finish any last bits for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Glad to hear it. Let’s keep it simple—check the supplies, then we can fill the gaps after lunch.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know after lunch. Hopefully it’s just a few tools left on the list.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Good plan. I’ll wait for your list after lunch, and we’ll take it from there.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the repair bins.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. That’ll keep things organized. After lunch, we’ll do a quick check and finish any last bits for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be ready after lunch for the quick check and any last bits.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the extension cord plus screws, nails, and cleaning supplies. See you at the repair drive.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Perfect, Sam — that covers the basics nicely. I’ll do a quick check after lunch and we’ll finish any last bits for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Great — I’ll be there with the supplies, and I’ll be ready to help with whatever’s left after lunch.
events.speaker: Sam
